get.description: Aggregated read-only statistics for the storage center dashboard: tenant capacity and growth, provider inventory and per-provider usage, binding health, and provider catalog coverage. checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the object bytes.

scopeType.description: Account scope. platform = a global default published by platform operators and readable from every tenant; tenant = the application tenant's own default; user = a personal account owned by one end user.

ownerUserId.description: Set only for user-scoped accounts: the owning user id.

vendorCode.description: Service provider vendor code, for example aliyun, tencent, aws, minio.

accountCode.description: Business-agnostic account code, unique per tenant/organization.

accountType.description: The identity shape of the credential, not the account's relationship to the tenant. The storage console stores an access-key pair and therefore always records `long_term_key`; a create request naming any other shape is rejected rather than silently overwritten. `temporary_credential` and the federated / managed families are reserved for accounts that authenticate through a broker or an identity provider.

externalAccountId.description: Upstream account identifier, for example the Aliyun UID.

capabilityCodes.description: What the account can serve; object_storage marks storage consumers.

credentialConfigured.description: Whether an active credential row exists for this account.

credentialCount.description: How many non-deleted credential rows the account owns.

isDefault.description: Whether this account is its scope's default for the vendor + environment, i.e. what a consumer gets when it does not name an account.

vendorCode.description: Service provider vendor code; the storage console derives it from the selected provider kind.

accountCode.description: Business-agnostic account code, unique per tenant/organization.

accountType.description: The identity shape of the credential, not the account's relationship to the tenant. The storage console stores an access-key pair and therefore always records `long_term_key`; a create request naming any other shape is rejected rather than silently overwritten. `temporary_credential` and the federated / managed families are reserved for accounts that authenticate through a broker or an identity provider.

scopeType.description: Account scope. platform = a global default published by platform operators and readable from every tenant; tenant = the application tenant's own default; user = a personal account owned by one end user. platform requires a platform operator; user defaults its owner to the caller.

ownerUserId.description: Set only for user-scoped accounts: the owning user id. Naming somebody else is rejected.

isDefault.description: Whether this account is its scope's default for the vendor + environment, i.e. what a consumer gets when it does not name an account. Promoting a new default demotes the previous one for the same vendor + environment.

secretAccessKey.description: Sealed into the write-only credential row; never echoed back.

providerKind.description: Built-in storage provider kind this row bootstraps.

providerId.description: Id of the provider configuration this kind bootstraps.

providerCreated.description: True when this call created the provider configuration.

vendorCode.description: Account-center vendor the provider is bound to; absent for a credential-free kind (local_filesystem).

providerAccountId.description: Account-center account the provider is bound to; absent for a credential-free kind.

accountCode.description: Stable account code of the bootstrapped account; absent for a credential-free kind.

accountCreated.description: True when this call created the account; false when an account already existed and was left untouched.

credentialSeeded.description: True when this call wrote the placeholder access-key pair. False means an account already existed, so its credential was deliberately not overwritten.

StorageOverview.description: Storage center dashboard aggregate. Capacity, usage and binding figures are computed over the same tenant scope so they are mutually consistent; the catalog block is platform-wide and intentionally not tenant-scoped.

generatedAt.description: Server timestamp the aggregate was computed at.

scopeTenantId.description: Tenant every capacity, usage and binding figure is scoped to. The catalog block is platform-wide and ignores this.

StorageOverviewCapacity.description: Tenant-level capacity figures derived from dr_drive_storage_object.

totalObjectCount.description: Object rows regardless of lifecycle status.

activeObjectCount.description: Objects currently in lifecycle status active.

usedBytes.description: Sum of content_length over active objects.

averageObjectBytes.description: Mean content_length over active objects; 0 when there are none.

largestObjectBytes.description: Largest active object content_length; null when there are none.

bucketCount.description: Distinct buckets that hold object rows in this scope.

quotaBytes.description: Tenant quota max_bytes; null when the tenant has no quota row.

quotaConfigured.description: True when a quota row exists with a non-null max_bytes.

quotaUsageRatio.description: usedBytes / quotaBytes. May exceed 1 when the quota is overrun; null without a quota.

StorageOverviewProviders.description: Tenant-scoped provider inventory: only providers this tenant actually depends on are counted, i.e. providers referenced by one of the tenant's bindings or holding one of its objects.

usage.description: Per-provider usage ordered by descending usedBytes.

StorageOverviewProviderUsage.description: One provider row of the usage breakdown.

status.description: Provider status: active, disabled or deleted.

usedBytes.description: Sum of content_length stored through this provider.

bindingCount.description: Active bindings that resolve to this provider.

isTenantDefault.description: True when this provider carries the tenant default binding.

capacityShare.description: Share of total used bytes held by this provider, 0..1.

totalCount.description: Binding rows regardless of lifecycle status.

inactiveCount.description: Bindings that are disabled or deleted.

hasTenantDefault.description: False means new writes in this tenant have no default provider.

tenantDefaultBindingId.description: Id of the tenant default binding; null when unset.

tenantDefaultProviderId.description: Provider resolved by the tenant default binding; null when unset.

tenantCount.description: Bindings scoped to the whole tenant.

spaceCount.description: Bindings scoped to a single space.

spaceTypeCount.description: Bindings scoped to a space type.

StorageOverviewCatalog.description: Platform-wide provider catalog (dr_drive_storage_provider_kind) coverage. The catalog has no tenant dimension, so these counts are shared by every tenant.

disabledCount.description: Catalog entries disabled for new configurations.

periodLabel.description: Closed month bucket label in YYYY-MM.

bytes.description: Sum of content_length created in that month.

item.description: Typed domain resource for the operation.
